Questions?

Is there a long-term contract?

Month-to-month after an initial 3-month commitment. Local SEO compounds over time — 90 days is the minimum to see meaningful movement. After 3 months, cancel anytime with 30 days notice.

What happens in the quarterly strategy call?

We review rankings, traffic, leads, and revenue impact. We adjust the content calendar, identify new service-area opportunities, and set priorities for the next quarter. You get a 1-page PDF summary + Loom walkthrough.

Do you write the blog posts or do I?

We write, optimize, and publish them. You approve topics via a shared Notion board. Posts target your service-area keywords and include local schema, internal links, and GBP post syndication.

How do you track rankings?

We use LocalFalcon / Places Scout for grid-based Maps tracking across your service areas, plus standard organic rank tracking for your top 20 keywords. Reports delivered monthly.

What if I need to pause?

Life happens. One pause per 12 months (up to 60 days) at 50% retainer to hold your slot. No penalty, no awkward conversations.

Can I upgrade/downgrade tiers?

Yes, anytime. Changes take effect next billing cycle. Prorated adjustments applied automatically.
